page.overview:
What is Pital?

Pital was a human-occupied world colonized during The Scattering, and one of the first attacked during the final plan to exterminate human-kind by Omnius and the reborn Thinking Machine Empire, during the advent of Kralizec.

With the planets Ronto and Duvalle, Pital experienced first what would be Omnius's plan to wipe out humanity. Probes seeded with the dreaded Omnius Scourge were first sent to the plant first, which would nearly wipe out the population of the world. Then the survivors would be barely able to defend the world against the Thinking Machine's million-starship space Armada.
